title: Chief Growth Officer
description:
Job Summary:
As a core executive leader in North America, the SVP & Chief Growth Officer is responsible for driving regional growth strategy, business expansion, and operational excellence. This role leads strategic planning and execution across the organization, overseeing alignment among product, channels, operations, logistics, and commercial functions. The position partners closely with the General Manager and Deputy General Manager to accelerate sustainable revenue growth, market expansion, and long-term profitability.

Du ties/Responsibilities:
• Develop and lead mid- to long-term growth strategies and annual business plans for North America; identify market opportunities to drive revenue growth, profitability, and market share expansion.
• Drive execution of strategic growth initiatives and business performance management;
establish operational tracking mechanisms and KPIs to ensure achievement of financial
targets, inventory health, and organizational objectives.
• Lead cross-functional collaboration across product management, supply chain, operations, sales, and marketing teams to optimize end-to-end business processes, organizational efficiency, and resource allocation.
• Optimize North America supply chain footprint, operational efficiency, and cost structure;
strengthen responsiveness, scalability, and risk management capabilities across the region.
• Build, expand, and strengthen strategic channels, partnerships, and ecosystem relationships to accelerate brand growth, platform expansion, and market penetration.
• Lead high-impact strategic initiatives, including business transformation, organizational
optimization, commercial expansion, and implementation of new business models and
growth opportunities.
• Establish and enhance a data-driven business intelligence and analytics framework to
generate actionable market insights, support executive decision-making, and identify future growth opportunities.

Required Skills/Abili ties:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing, Supply
Chain, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
• Minimum of 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in business growth, strategic
planning, operations, or executive management roles, preferably within consumer electronics, retail, or related industries.
• Proven track record of driving revenue growth, operational transformation, and
organizational scalability across multi-functional business environments.
• Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze financial performance, market trends,
operational metrics, and competitive positioning to support executive decision-making.
• Experience leading cross-functional teams and aligning sales, operations, supply chain,
product management, and marketing strategies to achieve business objectives.
• Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills with the ability to influence executive stakeholders, partners, and cross-regional teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach to strategic planning and performance management.
• Experience with ERP systems, business intelligence tools, and advanced Microsoft Office
applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth, and multicultural business
environment.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, complex initiatives, and time-sensitive business objectives.
